accounts.name: Dial a Spare Collections Control
accounts.purpose: Parent/combined statement view over channel clearing/cash accounts; no direct journal postings to avoid double counting.

accounts.name: Dial a Spare — Cash
accounts.purpose: Dedicated Cash collection/clearing balance for Dial a Spare.

accounts.name: Dial a Spare — EcoCash Direct USSD Push
accounts.purpose: Dedicated EcoCash Direct USSD Push collection/clearing balance for Dial a Spare.

accounts.name: Dial a Spare — Paynow
accounts.purpose: Dedicated Paynow collection/clearing balance for Dial a Spare.

accounts.name: Dial a Spare — ContiPay
accounts.purpose: Dedicated ContiPay collection/clearing balance for Dial a Spare.

accounts.name: Dial a Spare — PayPal
accounts.purpose: Dedicated PayPal collection/clearing balance for Dial a Spare.

accounts.name: Dial a Spare — Petty Cash
accounts.purpose: Controlled petty cash float. Funding is an internal transfer after approved requisition.

accounts.name: Dial a Spare — Returns / Refunds Control
accounts.purpose: Control/suspense account when return/refund accounting requires a temporary balance; final posting follows AccountingEvent mapping.

journals.name: Dial a Spare — EcoCash Direct USSD Push Journal
Dial a Spare — Combined Collections Journal
journals.purpose: Read-only combined journal projection of all channel journals and relevant cash movements; no duplicate GL postings.

journals.name: Dial a Spare — Petty Cash Journal
Dial a Spare — Returns & Refunds Journal
journals.purpose: Source journal for returns, refunds, reversals and approved credits; references original transaction.

journals.name: Dial a Spare — Payment Disputes & Chargebacks Journal
journals.purpose: Tracks PayPal/Paynow/provider/customer disputes without rewriting original receipts.

currency_rule: Running balance never mixes currencies. Combined view uses currency tabs/groups; reporting-currency equivalent is a separate FX-labelled analytics figure.
ledger_rule: All postings remain in the one canonical DIAL Ledger. Books/journals are scoped views/source journals, never independent ledgers.
